gaia_query: SELECT TOP 2000 source_id,ra,dec,ra_error,dec_error,pmra,pmdec,ref_epoch,phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',266.4,-28.9333,0.2)) AND pmra IS NOT NULL AND pmdec IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag < 15
limitations: Unknown image observation epochs prevent proper-motion propagation.
Gaia is independent; proximity does not certify source identity.
Pixel scales, PSFs and bands differ; covariance and observer geometry are unknown.
A single shared candidate cannot qualify a registration model or false-match rate.
